source.caption: Cross-system feature structure of recurrent top-35 feature sets. Stacked bars show counts in each education system of variables selected in all 20 school-grouped outer splits under the primary top-35 screening procedure, classified as recurrent in nine systems, shared by two to eight systems, or unique to one system.
